avis.texte: I recieved the .1 ounce tiny sampler a month ago from my esthetician. Oh my goodness. I used that little sampler for 30 days. Just the tiniest dot on wet skin is all you need. I loved how my skin felt after washing. I splurged and purchased the full size tube once I ran out of the sample. BEST DECISION EVER. My skin: 40s, African American, dry, severe hyperpigmentation on lower half of face, winter in cold climate. My skin LOVES this cleanser. We added a couple other topicals to my routine and my skin is in the best condition ever! This was just the skincare foundation I needed to get my skin on track.

avis.titre: Seems to work okay but feels greasy
avis.texte: I use a lot of Elta products but my face wash I use normally is by Drunk Elephant. I bought this for travel as the size is small enough to take on a plane. It has an oily feel to it and doesn't seem to leave my skin as clean as my Drunk Elephant.

avis.titre: Amazing cleaners for removing make up!
avis.texte: I was recommended this product by a friend who is an esthetician, and it has been a game changer. I wasn’t sure if I liked it at first but it’s been about a week now and it’s worked beautifully for removing my make up (mostly mascara) at night. It’s gentle and doesn’t feel like it’s stripping / drying out your skin. Your skin feels soft and hydrated after using it. I’ve also noticed my nose pores becoming smaller and less clogged which is a bonus! I have combination skin, and this didn’t cause me to break out at all since it’s an oil based cleaner.

My sister is a PA at a dermatologist office and recommended this to me. I have sensitive skin and most cleansers are too harsh for my skin, on top of drying it out. This product however has helped clear my skin! Apply it onto a dry face, and then add water! Rub in circles and rinse with a clean towel!

I highly recommend this product!!! It is very hydrating with stripping the skin, great moisturized feeling and a little goes a long way. Definitely incorporate into your nighttime double cleanse routine

I love this product! I have very sensitive skin and it did not cause any additional breakouts. My only complaint is that I have eyelash extensions and obviously anything with oil can negative affect those. I have come up with a solution and since that it’s been great. I use this with the morning duo and, it is a quick fast routine for good skin care .

I just started using this about a week ago as a friend recommended it for sensitive skin. It takes the make-up off my face effectively except mascara (not even water-proof). Eye make-up took a little more scrubbing to get off. It feels good and smooth on my skin. Non-irritating. You don't need much to cleanse. I was happy it did not cause redness or a rash. It is pretty expensive for the size of the tube.
The clean is awesome. It feels like butter. The results very satisfying.
Realmente retira rímel contra agua. Deja una sensación un poco grasosa y a veces no sé si logre limpiar rostro pero si retira el maquillaje

This EltaMD Oil-In-Gel Face Cleanser is an interesting product. It cleanses my face like my usual face wash, but leaves a moisturizing protective layer after rinsing. This acts as a protective barrier keeping my skin from drying out after washing. My skin is sensitive and tends to be acne prone whenever I use oily products, but I haven't had any irritation or breakouts from using this so far. In addition to liking the effectiveness of this gel cleanser, I also appreciate that it came well packaged with a safety seal under the flip-up cap. The package is also labeled with an expiration date over 2.5 years away. I'm very satisfied using this EltaMD Oil-In-Gel Face Cleanser and would order it again.

avis.titre: Oily gentle cleanser for sensitive skin
avis.texte: The EltaMD Oil-In-Gel Face Cleanser is a translucent gel that is unscented. Per instruction on the box, applied this onto dry skin, and tried to massage around, however, it was not that easy to do as this gel feels like silicone at contact, and it does not "transform into oil" to spread easily. I feel like I am rubbing my skin to spread it. It feels oily on the face. Adding water did make it easier to massage the skin, but it did not generate much milky emulsion as advised. After rinsing, it left a thin oily feel, the skin feels ok and hydrated after patting dry. This is a very gentle cleanser, it feels more like a makeup remover due to the oily quality and finish. I think that improvement in the texture, and viscosity will be better for application.

avis.titre: Best for removing makeup or sunscreen then cleansing
avis.texte: I found this worked best when I was using it to remove makeup or sunscreen. If I wasn’t wearing any makeup that day, rubbing the oil onto my face prior wasn’t really a step I found myself needing to do. On those days I just needed a straight cleanser. This is more for removing any layers you may have on your skin prior to cleansing. It’s a unique concept, reminds me of makeup melting balms I’ve used in the past, with the added step of it turning into a milky cleanser once you get it wet. You rub the product onto your skin while your skin is dry, and the oil will help breakdown/remove product. Then you wet your hands/face and it turns into a cleanser. After turning into a cleanser I didn’t find it sudsing up that much. I did use a good amount of product, too. So the cleansing portion felt very light to me and I found myself wishing for more suds. I was careful to avoid using this on my eye area because last time I used a makeup melting balm I had an allergic reaction on my eyes, so I’m always extra cautious on using oils near them. When I avoided my eyes (and just used this on the rest of my face) I had no sensitivities occur. Overall it’s a unique concept and would work good when used in combo to remove makeup or sunscreen. If I’m just wanting a light cleanse though I’d use my regular cleanser.

avis.titre: Gentle, Effective and keeps skin feeling hydrated
avis.texte: I really like this facial cleanser. It dispenses as an unscented, clear gel with a silky/oily feel to it. I squirt it onto my fingers and then apply to my face by rubbing in a circular motion. The gel just melts into my skin as I rub. If I add a little bit of water, it turns whitish and slightly creamy. Then, I just use a washcloth to wipe off the cleanser. It does a great job of removing my makeup, but leaves my skin feeling soft and not at all dried out, but not oily either. This does have a caution to avoid contact with eyes, so I have not used it to remove eye makeup. I usually use an eye makeup remover first and then use this everywhere else. The only downside to me is that I have two steps since I don't feel comfortable using this near my eyes.

avis.titre: I received a tube that was already used.
avis.texte: I don’t have any problem with the product. I’ve used this Delta MD product for years. The tube that was sent to me had been used before it was sent from the manufacturer and the seal at the opening was missing.

avis.titre: Cool gel-to-oil form that melts off make-up and sunscreen
avis.texte: EltaMD is sold at my dermatologist's office, so it's a trusted brand to me. But, this was my first time trying one of their cleansers. The Oil-in-Gel Cleanser is really interesting because it starts out as a gel and turns into an oil you apply it. I used it to remove heavily applied 23.4% zinc sunscreen, and it melted it off quickly and easily. The cleanser never really lathers, but it washes away clean and leaves the skin feeling soft and balanced. I'm very impressed with this product and recommend it for removing foundation and sunscreen.

This is a good basic oil cleanser. It comes out looking like a gel but definitely applies as an oil. It gets my face clean but doesn’t leave it dry or tight. That said, I wouldn’t repurchase this in the future, just because I find that my favorite cleansers have beautiful scents and textures, as I am a really sense-driven person. I don’t like an overwhelming type of scent, but a nice essential oil type scent (other than patchouli) makes me really happy, and so does a really smooth creamy type of cleanser. This is a nice cleanser, but I just don’t derive a lot of joy from using it. But if you like a good, solid, basic unscented cleanser, this would be a good option.

I enjoy how oil-based cleansers can effortlessly remove sunscreen without leaving my skin feeling dry. I followed the instructions and used this particular gel cleanser on my dry skin. I appreciate its texture as it allows for precise application. While adding water didn't visibly create an emulsion, it did help loosen the cleanser, allowing me to thoroughly cleanse every part of my face. Only a small quantity is needed, and it rinses off effortlessly, leaving no residue.

I’m a big fan of EltaMD’s sunscreen. I’ve been using it for many years. So I had high expectations for this new product ; Oil-in-Gel Face Cleanser. I used this cleanser for this past 2weeks and it’s beyond my expectations. Easy to use- tube type containers. Easy to apply to the face. Just apply my dry face. No need to prepare cotton balls or cotton pads. I just gently massage the gel all over the face. I spend more time massage around the t-zone. It helps minimize my pores and blackheads. It’s silky texture oil type. It doesn’t leave any extra greasy/oily feeling while completely removing all of my make-up (sunscreen & foundations) Fragrance-free.

I have sensitive hormonal/acne prone skin and this cleanser was just the right amount of moisturizing for me. It’s a little different washing your face dry before adding water but my face feels cleansed afterwards. Highly recommend!
